query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 774 AND 778),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('asean-cirdap-boundary-774','organizations-exam-boundary-775','organizations-exam-boundary-776','nato-isaf-boundary-777','security-alliance-boundary-778')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 774 AND 778),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 774 AND 778),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 774 AND 778),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 774 AND 778),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 774 AND 778),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0774-0778:%'),'search_documents',0) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
